purpose: Requirements for the consult skill, which runs dialogue with users: presenting topics as a progress table and concise briefs (summary plus recommendation), obtaining user decisions, and recording briefs, without executing undecided actions.
summary: Overview: consult responsibilities of overall progress table, per-topic brief, driving progress, decision capture, recording
Three usages: review delegation, dialogue-based revision, and new creation, each with different input and display means
Glossary and scope: evaluation, consult topic, consult brief, presentation state; in-scope and out-of-scope items
FNC-001/002: topic intake with verification before presenting; progress table with statuses, classification of unresolved items, skill-led ordering
FNC-003/006: brief of two fields (summary, recommendation) kept concise (about 10 lines), only correct options shown, source location attached
FNC-004/005: three-level confidence marks (checked, checked-unsure, unmarked) and restating context instead of referring back
FNC-007 to 010: Q&A without demanding decisions, withdrawal, adopt/reject/hold decisions, interruption, user owns resolution
FNC-012 to 014 and BL-001/002: main Claude writes briefs before speaking, briefs recorded via script as JSON, no execution of undecided matters, fidelity
NFR-001/002/004/005: one presentation-state store per usage, usage-specific logic separated from SKILL, secrets not shown, failures made visible
Open items TBD-002 to TBD-010: namespace, batch threshold, decision categories, brevity standard, recording location, resume, console-only criteria
tasks: Writing or revising the consult skill SKILL.md and per-usage procedure documents
Implementing consult scripts such as HTML generation and brief recording
Designing the delegation interface from review to consult
Reviewing consult requirements and design documents for consistency
Designing how to present findings or topics to users and obtain decisions
Defining progress table display format and status vocabulary
Handling confidential information in presentations and records
title: REQ-017 consult 対話進行スキル要件定義書
